required_change: Update chapter titles, section links, related-resource IDs, figure/table references, package version, synthetic-data notice and citation fields. Remove hard-coded page numbers.
End analyses with use-case-specific readiness implications; separate remediable defects, pilot uncertainties and deployment-stopping deficiencies.
Align decision-curve defaults and notes with the revised readmission example; report threshold range, comparator strategies and decision utility, not accuracy alone.
Add signal, interpretation and action latency where relevant; require action-owner and capacity constraints in outputs.
Add net labour saving, quality adjustment, fragmentation, work transfer, bottlenecks, capacity usability, capacity destination, work intensity and persistence.
Expand from descriptive charts to surveillance records that identify signals, escalation, corrective action, effectiveness verification and closure.
Separate economic cost, cash expenditure and accounting expense; add budget incidence, lifecycle timing, residual value and renewal/exit scenarios.
Add explicit financial-recognition rules, NPV, ROI, payback, downside exposure and non-cash capacity benefits.
Report efficiency frontier, dominance, ICER and NMB consistently, with explicit decision threshold and comparator.
Produce annual and cumulative budget impact by responsible budget holder and distinguish cashable offsets from capacity effects.
Separate subgroup performance, access, outcomes, costs, opportunity costs and mitigation; report distribution without allowing averages to override safeguards.
Make one-way sensitivity and threshold analysis the principal outputs; label values synthetic and connect drivers to decision questions.
Retain PSA, CEAC and EVPI; add EVPPI when defensible and add EVSI/ENBS or a clearly documented approximate route for staged research decisions.
Add an explicit AI-characteristics specification: threshold, review burden, adoption, delay, drift, update, version, capacity and human response where material.
Extend vendor comparison and pricing analyses to continuing disclosure, upstream dependencies, post-award obligations, change control, renewal and exit.
Add residual-risk authority, contestability, assurance independence and reauthorization fields to governance/risk outputs.
Attach each result to an evidentiary claim and estimand; state what the design can establish, unresolved limitations, transportability and material-change re-evaluation triggers.
Convert monitoring outputs into trigger evaluations linked to current version, decision state, default response, accountable authority and evidence required for reauthorization.
Audit decision provenance and current authorization rather than producing a reassuring aggregate completeness score.
Add stocks, flows, loop level, circular leakage, functional unit, resource intensity, rebound, induced demand and spatial distribution.
Add eligibility gate before EAC, supported service life, obsolescence/dependency scenarios, realizable residual value, availability and closure conditions.

Rebase on the AI-assisted remote diagnostic pathway; reconcile economic/environmental boundaries; distinguish average/marginal consequences; add double-counting tests, incomplete monetisation, rebound, resilience and burden transfer.

Add an optional lifecycle decision-state and trigger engine that reads versioned monitoring/change records and produces a transparent recommended transition requiring human authorization. It must not auto-authorize clinical use.
